subject: general
question: Ganpat starts from point A and walks 18 m west. He turns left, walks 32 m, then turns left again, walks 26 m, then turns left again, walks 61 m, and stops at point B. Meena starts from point Z, which is 22 m east of point A. She walks 42 m north, turns right, walks 35 m, turns right and walks 13 m, and stops at point Y. Find the shortest distance between point B and point Y. (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa20de098de0df50eccdebc19f023b7b549b66a238f9b4a0b1f816668aed3b7.png] 

Shortest distance between B and Y = ((18 + 22) - 26) + 35

⟹ (40 - 26 ) + 35

⟹ 14 + 35

⟹ 49 m

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
